spec_artifact.description: Path to the P4 spec artifact that was processed

requirements_total.description: Total EARS requirements found in spec artifact

requirements_covered.description: Requirements with at least one complete stub

stubs_generated.description: Total stubs written (may be greater than requirements_covered due to multiple stubs per requirement)

incomplete_stubs.description: Stubs written with incomplete fields (expected: TBD or empty)

test_plan_path.description: Path to test plan document in .wabblespec/plans/

reviewer_triggered.description: Whether Reviewer was consulted due to high untestable percentage
